notablePrerequisites: Emry and Embraal Gear-Smasher do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Embraal Gear-Smasher, sacrificing Paradise Mantle to deal 2 damage to each opponent.
Tap Emry, targeting Paradise Mantle.
Cast Paradise Mantle.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
